summary: Channel Mission Bay is a 315-unit apartment building (per its DBI permit) at 185 Channel St in Mission Bay, developed by DOB Mission Bay LP (per the project page of LaHue and Associates, a signage firm that lists itself for the building's signage) and listed by UDR as one of its communities. DBI records permit #201104224606 (8 stories, 315 units) as completed on July 22, 2014; DataSF Assessor tax-roll data are consistent with that: assessed improvement value rose from $0 in the 2012 roll to $30M in 2013 and $94M in 2014, with 316 units first recorded in the 2015 roll.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #201104224606 filed to erect an 8-story, 315-unit residential/retail/parking building at 185 Channel St; a SocketSite article one week earlier (2011-04-15) reported that "United Dominion Trust is planning to break ground on 315 rental units and 9,000 square feet of retail on Block 2 in the third quarter" (an expected date; the article gives no year or street address, and the match to this building rests on the same 315-unit count)

DBI records permit #201104224606 (8 stories, 315 units) as completed; Assessor tax-roll data are consistent (assessed improvement value $0 in the 2012 roll, $30M in 2013, $94M in 2014; 316 units first recorded in the 2015 roll). A completion date for the permit is not an opening date.

open_questions: DBI records permit #201104224606 as completed on 2014-07-22 (DataSF i98e-djp9), but a permit completion is not an opening date; no source found states when the building opened or first leased.

This parcel's own DataSF Assessor 'year_property_built' field is blank in every roll year checked -- unlike most other Mission Bay buildings checked, the Assessor does not give a direct construction year for this parcel.

Several real-estate listing aggregators (Zillow, Trulia, Apartments.com) state the building was 'built in 2013,' which is consistent with the Assessor's value trend, but these pages could not be checked and their exact wording is not confirmed, so that claim is not used as a citation here.

The building's developer (DOB Mission Bay LP) and the LaHue and Associates/UDR project pages already cited for this record do not themselves give an opening date, and no other source found confirms the opening year.

The Market Hall's opening year is not shown. Pier & Point's earlier retail list gave 2016, which rested on a Yelp listing that could not be read (access refused again on 2026-10-12). Tablehopper (2014-06-10, relaying Eater) reported it as planned for the ground floor of the Channel Mission Bay building at 185 Channel St. at 4th St., with the restaurateur hoping "to open around Labor Day" 2014 (an expected date, written before any opening); an earlier note cited an SFist item of 2014-06-09 for this, which could not be found again. No source read states when it opened or closed, so its closed status also rests on the unread Yelp listing. Gus's Community Market's own site (src-gus-mission-bay) lists a Mission Bay Market at 1101 4th St, "Located at 4th and Channel", read 2026-09-29 and again on 2026-10-12.
